title: doit desk-nudge panel
description: One step of the desk nudge's panel, read from the rows that the watch keeps in $XDG_CACHE_HOME/doit/desk-nudge-panel.json. `doit tui` draws each row and hands the picked key to `doit desk-nudge panel pick`, which prints the next step. Written by doit.desk_nudge.write_schemas from the module, so edit the module rather than this file.

step.description: today's rows, a timed pursuit's minutes, or done once a pick has acted.

rows.description: What to draw, in order. Empty on a done step.

key.description: What `panel pick` takes. Null on a note, which completes nothing.

kind.description: A note, an answer, what a completion completes, or a step through the minutes.

group.description: The due lane a completion row came from, which it is drawn under. Null on every other row.

minutes.description: The minutes a minutes row logs or reopens at. Null on every other row.

suggested.description: A completion row completes the suggestion, which `doit next` put first. On a log_minutes row, the amount that the step offers first, and that its ±5 rows count from.

message.description: What a done step did. Null on every other step.
